According to the circulars currently in force:
- **GP 2/2025**, clause 3.4 (In force): "Information classified Rahsia or Rahsia Besar must remain on-premise in the Government Data Centre." [S1]
- **GP 2/2025**, clause 3.1 (In force): "Information classified Terbuka may be stored in any approved cloud service." [S2]
